thread:
maria_ae: AuroraHealth POC morning check-in. They're hitting steady 429s and occasional 401s during a document ingestion replay. Need quick triage and pricing guidance for Dedicated trial.

jamal_se: On it. What's their traffic pattern and SDK usage?

maria_ae: Replay: ~80 reqs/s for 10 minutes, prompts ~300 tokens. Using our hosted SDK and API key. First 429 at 10:05 UTC.

nina_infra: Can I see an example log line and client id?

maria_ae: client_id=aurora-poc. Snippet they shared: ```[2026-05-02T10:05:12Z] 429 POST /v1/generate - client=aurora-poc - {"error":"rate_limited"}```

ethan_sre: Looks like token/req rate limit on hosted tier. Also saw some 401s that align with brief key validation errors from our auth service. Tailing logs now.

deploy-bot: Autoscaler: scaled up redwood-medium pool by +1 pod in us-east-1 at 2026-05-02T10:08:40Z.

nina_infra: They have 10 workers hitting concurrently from multiple IPs. For hosted default soft burst this can exceed limits. Options: temporary burst quota, per-tenant queuing, or move to Dedicated.

priya_csm: I'll collect their security questionnaire and ask about timeline for Dedicated trial. Maria, can you confirm whether they require HIPAA BAA?

maria_ae: They indicated PHI is in scope and asked about HIPAA.

jamal_se: For Dedicated trial lead time: typical 5	6 days. Short-term Dedicated sandbox available for 14 days with uplift. For immediate relief we can grant 48h soft-burst if infra approves.

nina_infra: I can approve 48h soft-burst and enable per-client queuing. Applying now.

deploy-bot: RateLimitUpdate applied: tenant=aurora-poc, burst_tokens=250k, window=48h at 2026-05-02T10:12:11Z.

ethan_sre: Monitoring auth service for 401 spike. If key validation errors continue we'll ask customer to rotate keys and check SDK version.

priya_csm: Action items: (1) maria to get security questionnaire + HIPAA note (EOD), (2) jamal to send Dedicated trial pricing + SLAs (by 17:00 PT), (3) nina/ethan monitor 48h and escalate if 429s/401s persist.

maria_ae: Thanks all. I'll update Aurora and ask them to throttle replay to 60 reqs/s while we observe.

ethan_sre: Marking monitored. Will open incident if 429 rate >1% sustained for 5 minutes. :eyes:
